content: The coadministration of cannabidiol and CYP2B6 substrates may lead to both induction and inhibition of CYP2B6. It is recommended to consider dosage adjustments of CYP2B6 substrates as clinically appropriate. Rifampin reduces carvedilol levels or effects by increasing its metabolism through hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases caspofungin levels by enhancing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Cenobamate reduces rifampin levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Increase the dose of CYP2B6 substrates as needed when coadministered with cenobamate. Rifampin decreases cevimeline levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces chlordiazepoxide levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases chloroquine levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin increases the toxicity of cholic acid by reducing its elimination. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Avoid concurrent use of bile salt efflux pump (BSEP) inhibitors, as this may exacerbate the accumulation of conjugated bile salts in the liver, leading to clinical symptoms. If coadministration is unavoidable, monitor serum transaminases and bilirubin levels. Rifampin reduces citalopram levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases clarithromycin levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces clomipramine levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases clonazepam levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces clorazepate levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Clotrimazole increases rifampin levels or effects through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Coadministration with cotrimoxazole increases rifampin concentrations, potentially raising the risk of toxicity. Monitor for adverse reactions during coadministration. Rifampin decreases clozapine levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces conjugated estrogens levels or effects by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases cortisone levels or effects by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces crizotinib levels by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crizotinib increases rifampin levels by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases cyclophosphamide levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces cyclosporine levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Danicopan increases rifampin levels or effects by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Danicopan increases plasma concentrations of P-gp substrates; consider dose reduction of P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious adverse reactions. Rifampin decreases dantrolene levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces daprodustat levels or effects through other mechanisms. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. CYP2C8 inducers may decrease daprodustat exposure, potentially resulting in a loss of efficacy. Monitor hemoglobin levels and adjust daprodustat dosage when initiating or discontinuing CYP2C8 inducers during treatment. Rifampin decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces daunorubicin levels or effects by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases deferasirox levels through other mechanisms. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Avoid coadministration of potent UGT inducers with deferasirox. If coadministration is required, consider increasing the initial dose of deferasirox to 30 mg/kg and monitor ferritin levels and clinical response. Rifampin reduces deflazacort levels or effects by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases dexamethasone levels or effects by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces dexlansoprazole levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases diazepam buccal levels or effects by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may increase the rate of diazepam elimination, potentially reducing its efficacy. Rifampin reduces diazepam intranasal levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may increase the rate of diazepam elimination, potentially reducing its efficacy. Rifampin decreases digoxin levels or effects by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter and increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces disopyramide levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases docetaxel levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces dolutegravir levels or effects by increasing its metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Increase the dolutegravir dosage when coadministering with strong UGT1A/CYP3A4 inducers. Use an alternative to rifampin in patients with integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI)-associated resistance substitutions or suspected INSTI resistance, as coadministration may result in therapeutic failure and resistance development. Rifampin decreases donepezil levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces doxepin cream levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases doxorubicin levels or effects by affecting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces doxorubicin liposomal levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases dronabinol levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. Rifampin reduces dutasteride levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases duvelisib levels or effects by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces efavirenz levels or effects by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases elafibranor levels or effects by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin increases elagolix levels or effects through other mechanisms. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases rifampin levels by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Rifampin reduces elagolix levels or effects by influencing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Limit the concomitant use of elagolix 150 mg daily and rifampin to six months. Eliglustat increases rifampin levels by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Monitor therapeutic drug concentrations or consider reducing the dosage of the P-gp substrate and titrate to clinical effect. Rifampin reduces eltrombopag levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Eltrombopag increases rifampin levels by decreasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended.
